name: Analog Test
description: Raspberry Pi Pico: reads the internal temperature sensor (ADC channel 4, %IW8), converts it to degrees C in %QW4 and flags an implausible reading on %Q0.0. Analog input only: the Pico HAL has no DAC.

outputs.name: SensorFault
outputs.description: GP0 in the Pico overlay: ON while the reading is not a plausible temperature

adc.name: TempRaw
adc.description: ADC channel 4 = RP2040 internal temperature sensor (the HAL maps channel n to %IW(4+n))
